newsitem.title: UK: Tuskar rig heading to Obe oil field off Niger Delta.
newsitem.headline: Tuskar rig heading to Obe oil field off Niger Delta.

text.p: A jack-up oil rig is being towed off the coast of Nigeria towards the Obe oil field in the Western Niger Delta and should be in place on June 22, independent oil and gas group Tuskar Resources Plc said on Thursday.

The Dublin-based group said in a statement the Adriatic X jack-up rig has been contracted to drill Tuskar's first development well on the Obe oil field, the Obe-4, in replacement of the Falrig 83 which became unavailable.
The Obe oil field is located in shallow waters in the OML 110 concession which covers an area of approximately 240,000 acres in the Niger Delta.
Tuskar's first development well on the field will be drilled to a multi-zone target and to a total depth of about 8,500 feet.

Previous exploration wells on the field, Obe-1 and Obe-3 have respectively flowed oil at 3,500 and 1,850 barrels per day from separate zones which will be targeted for dual completion for development purposes, the company said.
